backlog.title: Merge hardened PAF bootstrap baseline
backlog.objective: Preserve the merged stage-0 bootstrap baseline.

backlog.title: Implement PAF wire identity and canonical form
backlog.objective: Preserve the completed identity, canonical form, typed digest, negotiation, migration, registry, and cross-language conformance work.

backlog.title: Implement common models and architecture-to-Work-Graph refinement
backlog.objective: Implement the minimal PAF v11 common model envelope; Intent, Problem, Solution, System, Activity, and Work Graph payloads; RefinementRequest/Proposal/Review/Decision; repository-state projection; reviewed Work Graph proposals; deterministic traceability, dependency, active-work, and semantic-drift validation; and atomic accepted Work Graph activation.

backlog.title: Unify bootstrap phase identity and monitoring
backlog.objective: Represent generation, task critique, task repair, implementation, validation, checkpoint, implementation review, publication, and completion as unambiguous active/historical phases with one stable status projection.

backlog.title: Implement prerequisite checks and explicit recovery operations
backlog.objective: Reject unresolved authoritative prerequisites before execution and distinguish retry, continue, remediation, task revision, regeneration, partial recovery, effect reconciliation, upstream model revision, replanning, supersession, rollback, and termination.

backlog.title: Implement partial-work manifests and compatibility-aware recovery
backlog.objective: Capture exact partial work, completed criteria, validations, assumptions, external effects, attempt lineage, and compatibility checks before reuse.

backlog.title: Implement reusable refinement kernel behind bootstrap compatibility commands
backlog.objective: Move model validation, refinement proposal lifecycle, independent critique/repair, promotion, supersession, and Work Graph selection into reusable paf modules while preserving current campaign CLI behavior.

backlog.title: Implement capability contracts, routes, and local execution adapter
backlog.objective: Implement semantic CapabilityContracts, adapter conformance, route decisions, dynamic switching boundaries, local process execution, normalized errors, cancellation, partial results, and effect receipts.

backlog.title: Implement evidence, assessment, and evaluator-integrity contracts
backlog.objective: Implement AssessmentProtocol, evidence and claim records, criterion/completion assessments, evaluator firewall, promotion decisions, and audit/evidence/completion package projections.

backlog.title: Convert the Cline bootstrap into a conforming PAF execution backend
backlog.objective: Move Cline profiles, invocation, events, review resume, workspace identity, health, result normalization, and publication integration behind PAF capability and execution interfaces while retaining existing CLI and recovery compatibility.
